Meanwhile, ViX is home to more than 40,000 hours of Spanish-language programming, from original movies and series, to live sports like Liga MX and UEFA Champions League soccer, and live news that you can watch online without cable. Stream content live or on-demand from your computer, phone, tablet or smart TV.

The ViX Gratis tier is a free tier with on-demand movies, series, soap operas, sports and more. ViX Premium is a paid tier that unlocks an additional 10,000 hours of content, including full seasons of shows, exclusive movie premieres and exclusive telenovela premieres.

Popular shows on ViX, include María Félix: La Doña , La Mujer del Diablo , El Roomie , and Lo Que La Vida Me Robó , in addition to films like Sin ti no puedo, Flow calle: El reality and hundreds of hours of your favorite novellas. Get ViX Premium here .
